author: The Current
description:
MC Taylor of Hiss Golden Messenger talks about the magic of Woodstock
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

MC Taylor of Hiss Golden Messenger lives in the Piedmont of North Carolina, and he wrote most of his new album, "I'm People," in his home studio there. But when it came time to record the album, he and co-producer Josh Kaufman decided to do the work at Dreamland studio in Woodstock, New York. According to Taylor, there's so much more to Woodstock than being the site of the famous festival that bears its name. "There is definitely a charge to the air in that place," he says. 

Watch more of what Hiss Golden Messenger has to say about Woodstock in the video above.

author: The Current
description:
Watch a full concert by Stereolab, recorded live in Minneapolis in October 2025
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Stereolab have long held the ability to paradoxically both defy and define musical genres. Since forming in 1990, Stereolab have consistently demonstrated a penchant of artfully blending a variety of musical expressions to create something wholly different. It’s that quality that has made Stereolab one of the most influential bands to emerge from the nascent decade of alternative music — and it’s their innovative nature that keeps them at the forefront of musical invention and experimentation.

Stereolab’s most recent album is 2025’s Instant Holograms on Metal Film. Five months after that album’s release, Stereolab found themselves at the storied Minneapolis music venue First Avenue, where they performed to a sold-out room filled with enthusiastic fans.
